name: Black Truffle Pasta Purseittes
whyItWorks: Signature Disney Cruise Line delicacy: delicate, ultra-thin white pasta purses filled with smooth truffle cheese in a light champagne cream sauce — zero fibrous skins or chunks.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order as your starter (or ask for an entrée-sized double portion!) at Animator's Palate. Take a Lactaid enzyme if sensitive to cheese/cream.
watchOuts: Dairy cheese filling and cream sauce if lactose sensitive
